say:1:1130513001:1.text: If it were up to me, I wouldn't be sticking around. Not with the Claws running rampant.
say:1:1130513001:1.source_cn: 唉，能选肯定不会住在这里，都是因为流沙之爪。
say:1:1130513001:1.male: If it were up to me, I wouldn't be sticking around. Not with the Claws running rampant.
say:1:1130513001:1.female: If it were up to me, I wouldn't be sticking around. Not with the Claws running rampant.

say:2:1130513002:1.text: A lot of settlements have come under attack lately and plenty of folks are still missing. Tuktu and I have set up camp far away to avoid being targeted.
say:2:1130513002:1.source_cn: 近期聚落频频被劫，连人也失踪了不少，我和图克图为了不被...
say:2:1130513002:1.male: A lot of settlements have come under attack lately and plenty of folks are still missing. Tuktu and I have set up camp far away to avoid being targeted.
say:2:1130513002:1.female: A lot of settlements have come under attack lately and plenty of folks are still missing. Tuktu and I have set up camp far away to avoid being targeted.

say:3:1130513003:1.text: But it's rough out here. At least in the settlements people look after one another and share resources.
say:3:1130513003:1.source_cn: 就是出来生存不太方便，在聚落里，粮食和水都是大家一起搜...
say:3:1130513003:1.male: But it's rough out here. At least in the settlements people look after one another and share resources.
say:3:1130513003:1.female: But it's rough out here. At least in the settlements people look after one another and share resources.

say:4:1130513004:1.text: We can reinforce our tents against sandstorms, but we can only tighten our belts so far without food...
say:4:1130513004:1.source_cn: 面对沙暴我们还能加固帐篷，少了粮食就只能勒紧腰带忍着了……
say:4:1130513004:1.male: We can reinforce our tents against sandstorms, but we can only tighten our belts so far without food...
say:4:1130513004:1.female: We can reinforce our tents against sandstorms, but we can only tighten our belts so far without food...
